name: Info message
description: Persistent guidance beside the settings or content it explains.
sourceBasis: Source-based recreation of the Designer app's shared idea helper box (shared/components/idea-helper-box/idea-helper-box.component.ts), reviewed against Designer checkout 855605bdb7 on 2026-09-08. Not a Figma extraction; there is no figmaLink.

props.name: content
props.description: Plain text or caller-authored markup. The base wrapper uses 12px / 18px regular text; nested elements can override it.

props.name: icon
props.description: The component exposes an icon slot, but no custom icon was found in the reviewed Info call sites. Icon size otherwise inherits from its context.

props.name: placement
props.description: Callers set full, half, or content width and surrounding margins. These are layout choices, not size variants.

props.name: width
props.description: Rendered as width 100% (fill) or fit-content (fit), always with max-width 100% and min-width 0.

documentationPreviewControls.name: preview width
documentationPreviewControls.note: Narrow caps the documentation canvas at 320px. It changes only the canvas, not the component.

content.name: Plain
content.description: Body text only. Default preview copy: "Provider and Webhook Behavior are a one time selection. Once saved these cannot be changed."

content.name: Action
content.description: Body with a short inline action (a button or link) in Blue 500, inheriting the body font. Example: "Email Triggers can be activated from [Manage Triggers] in Runtime".

content.name: Emphasis
content.description: Body with selective bold on the essential words. Example: "Scope is a one time configuration. Once saved it **cannot be modified**."

content.name: Short
content.description: Short single-line body used for the width examples: "Files are combined in the order shown (min. two files)".

width.name: Fit
width.description: Fits the content (fit-content), capped at the container width (max-width 100%).

variations.title: None. There is no title slot; the message is a single text block.
variations.dismiss: None. The baseline has no timer or close control.

observedAppVariations.name: Shared Info tip
observedAppVariations.difference: The inspected app still uses a 4px radius; the design-system reference now specifies 8px. Neutral 50 fill, no border, 8px padding and gap. Neutral 700 text at 12px / 18px, weight 400. Top-aligned content with a 22px-high lightbulb slot. The icon inherits its size; the plain webhook example inherits 16px.

observedAppVariations.name: Inline link
observedAppVariations.difference: Message event configuration and webhook details project a Blue 500 link into the same 12px body. Container styling stays unchanged.

observedAppVariations.name: Muted body
observedAppVariations.difference: Invite User projects a Neutral 500 span, overriding the shared Neutral 700 body. The wrapper, spacing and icon stay the same.

observedAppVariations.name: Larger content and button
observedAppVariations.difference: Email settings puts text-sm on the host and a nested content row, producing 14px / 20px content and a 14px inherited icon. It supplies a Manage Triggers button. This is a caller override, not a larger Info variant.

observedAppVariations.name: Width and visibility
observedAppVariations.difference: Message events use half-width hosts; workflow input parameters use content width with max-width: 100%; user dialogs hide the helper when there is no content. These do not change the shared inner treatment.

observedAppVariations.name: Separate settings tips
observedAppVariations.difference: MS Graph and database settings also build lightbulb tips directly: 12px / 16px Neutral 500 text, centered icon alignment, 8px padding and 4px radius. Several include bold phrases. These do not use the shared idea helper box.

observedAppVariations.name: React file-combination tip
observedAppVariations.difference: 12px / 18px Neutral 700 text and 4px radius, with a centered 16px lightbulb using an 18px line box. The shared Angular helper uses a 22px icon slot and top alignment.

observedAppVariations.name: Other lightbulb treatments
observedAppVariations.difference: UI Flow uses 6px corners and Tailwind Gray 500 text; chat display guidance has no radius class. Metadata tips use 6px corners and Neutral 500. Reply-trigger guidance uses 8px corners, Neutral 600 and 18px line height. A copy-resource tip uses a 12px inline icon instead of the flex layout.

observedAppVariations.name: Dark document-processing tip
observedAppVariations.difference: A separate processing notice uses Neutral 700 fill, Neutral 200 text, 8px radius and centered alignment. It is not a dark variant of the shared Info tip.

variations.note: Observed app variations are caller differences in Designer, not a supported variant API. Only the documented baseline is the design-system reference.

statesNote: Static message with no interactive states. An inline action inside the body underlines on hover and shows a 2px focus-visible outline with 2px offset.
sizesNote: No size axis. The site shows a single style reference; container width follows the caller and is not a size variant.

anatomy.name: Container
anatomy.description: Gray surface with 8px padding, 8px corners, and no border. Horizontal flex row, children aligned to the top (flex-start), 8px gap.

anatomy.name: IconSlot
anatomy.description: Fixed 16px wide, 22px high alignment slot; flex, centered both ways, does not shrink.

anatomy.name: Icon
anatomy.description: Outlined yellow lightbulb (Phosphor Lightbulb, regular weight), 16x16, aria-hidden.

anatomy.name: Body
anatomy.description: Explanatory text at 12px / 18px. Supports inline links or buttons and selective bold emphasis. Text wraps without truncation (overflow-wrap anywhere, min-width 0); the icon stays at the top in its fixed alignment slot.

documentationSurface.note: The site previews the Info message on a white surface so the gray message background stays visible.

placement.relativeTo: Beside the settings or content it explains; keep it visible while its condition applies.
placement.width: Fill the column or fit the content, without exceeding the available width. Callers choose full, half, or content width and the surrounding margins; these are layout choices, not size variants.
placement.notForFieldHelp: Keep field-specific instructions and validation with their control. Use a callout for context affecting a section or task.
placement.observed: Message events use half-width hosts; workflow input parameters use content width with max-width 100%; user dialogs hide the helper when there is no content.

useCase.title: Explain a setting
useCase.description: Clarify how a setting works or what happens when it changes.

do.title: Link to the relevant destination
do.description: Use a short, keyboard-accessible inline action to open related settings.

do.title: Emphasize only the essential words
do.description: Bold key terms or consequences. Keep 12px / 18px text and allow wrapping.

do.title: Choose width to suit the context
do.description: Fill the column or fit the content, without exceeding the available width.

sharedBase.note: Defined on the shared inline-message base spec. The Info message page itself renders only the items above.

do.title: Keep context beside the affected content
do.description: Place an Info tip beside the settings it explains and a warning above the content affected by the consequence.

do.title: Keep essential information visible
do.description: Leave the message available while its condition applies. A brief toast cannot replace persistent guidance.

dont.title: Do not infer one universal style
dont.description: The shared Info tip and the page-authored warning have different spacing and typography. Similar-looking call sites also contain local variations.

dont.title: Do not promote field help into a banner
dont.description: Keep field-specific instructions and validation with their control. Use a callout for context affecting a section or task.

considerations: The underlying idea helper also implements a Warning type. That borderless orange treatment is separate from this Info message reference.
When projecting links or nested markup, check inherited text and icon sizes. Email settings overrides both with larger text.
Use a contrasting preview surface so the gray message background remains visible.
The baseline has no timer or close control.

accessibility.role: Static context needs no live role. Announce dynamic feedback according to urgency.
keyboard: Tab: keep interactive links and controls in the normal reading order.
Focus: do not move focus merely because a result appears.
aria: aria-hidden: decorative icons are hidden; the text carries the meaning.
aria-describedby: associate a message with an affected control when appropriate.
aria-live: the source template declares no live region. If an important result changes dynamically, its caller must provide appropriate announcement behavior.

decisionLog.decision: Use an 8px radius for the Info message.
decisionLog.reasoning: Design direction confirmed by the user; replaces the 4px radius observed in the current app implementation.

gaps: No dark-mode treatment is defined. The rendered component uses the same palette tokens in both themes and globals.css does not redefine --flowx palette variables under .dark, so colors.dark simply repeats colors.light.
No title element exists (no title slot), so title typography and color are undefined.
The bold emphasis is a plain <strong> element; no numeric font weight is specified for it in the sources.
The inline action's corner radius is set with the Tailwind class rounded-sm and its focus outline color is the browser/theme default; neither pixel radius nor outline color is stated in the sources.
Hover and pressed states for the action are limited to an underline; no hover text color is defined.
Icon color for a custom projected icon is not defined; only the default lightbulb color (yellow-500) is specified.
No Figma source exists for this component; values come from the Designer app source and the site's rendered recreation.
The spec and the rendered component agree on every value; the only documented deviation is the 8px radius versus the 4px radius still in the inspected app (see decisionLog).
